ethical_risks.title: Source-selection bias can under-represent minority or local viewpoints
ethical_risks.evidence: Linked limitations: Source-selection and credibility-rubric bias.
ethical_risks.mitigation: Add multi-source retrieval diversification and periodic expert review of credibility rubric.

ethical_risks.title: Overconfident outputs may mislead users in high-stakes domains
ethical_risks.mitigation: Calibrate confidence and display uncertainty reasons with explicit human-review triggers.

ethical_risks.title: Residual model error can amplify misinformation if used as sole authority
ethical_risks.evidence: Observed error rate=0.286 in evaluation split.
ethical_risks.mitigation: Position system as triage aid, not final truth authority; require human-in-loop for critical claims.

ethical_risks.title: Debate mode may alter verdicts without guaranteed net safety improvement
ethical_risks.evidence: Linked limitations: Debate arbitration can introduce regressions.
ethical_risks.mitigation: Enable debate only when baseline uncertainty exceeds policy threshold.

ethical_risks.title: Users may misunderstand confidence and think verdicts are definitive
ethical_risks.evidence: Current UX exposes confidence numbers but users may interpret them as certainty.
ethical_risks.mitigation: Add concise disclaimers and confidence interpretation bands in UI.

deployment_guardrails: Do not use as sole decision-maker for legal, medical, or electoral enforcement decisions.
Automatically require human review for low-confidence or high-risk domain claims.
Log model decisions and uncertainty reasons for post-hoc auditing.
Track domain-level disparity metrics and review monthly for drift or bias.
Publish model limitations and update rubric changelog transparently.

Immediate (0-2 weeks): Display explicit 'assistive tool' warning in results UI.
Enable policy rule: mandatory human review under confidence threshold.
Add operational alert on spikes in disagreement/error rate.
Near-term (2-6 weeks): Run expert panel audit for credibility rubric and source weighting.
Expand benchmark with underrepresented domains and multilingual samples.
Mid-term (6-12 weeks): Introduce fairness dashboard with group/domain parity monitoring.
Add independent retrieval providers to reduce single-source bias.
Formalize governance review cadence and incident response playbook.
